fib: ______ means whole sale market as was held in BRIG NEWMAN & CO.
Market value means whole sale market as was held in BRIG NEWMAN & CO.
______ is a paradigm shift from what used to be obtainable in both the BAC and the VAT-T.
Appeal process under the tribunal is a paradigm shift from what used to be obtainable in both the BAC and the VAT-T.
______ is used where it is impossible for the administrator to use parameters for the normal basis period to calculate the tax.
Abnormal basis period of assessment is used where it is impossible for the administrator to use parameters for the normal basis period to calculate the tax.
______ is described as an individual or a businessperson.
Please note that a person is described as an individual or a businessperson.
______ is the tax base in Nigeria like any other developing countries in the world.
Income is the tax base in Nigeria like any other developing countries in the world.
______ is the period, the profit of which is to be assessed in a year of assessment.
Basis period of assessment is the period, the profit of which is to be assessed in a year of assessment.
